author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Black Mirror wasn’t supposed to be a documentary... 

Meta has been granted a patent for an AI system that can analyze your past posts and messages to keep posting for you after you die. 

The goal is apparently to simulate your presence when you’re "absent."

#Meta #AI #AInews
title: Meta Patents AI To Post After You’re Dead
